title: Cozy Escape - 2 Bd 15 Min From Downtown Nashville
description:
Our lovely townhome is located just 15 minutes from downtown Nashville.  It's close enough to enjoy all that Music City has to offer, but far enough away in a peaceful and quiet neighborhood to guarantee that you'll get a great night's sleep on our comfortable beds.  There's a large outdoor deck to enjoy gathering outside.
